text:
Type: rectangular solid pine table
Use: dining, working at a desk; dining room, kitchen, home office
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: untreated solid pine, small painted metal tray under one end
Colors: light natural pine, pale mint green accent
Shape: plain rectangular top with rounded corners, slim apron, four straight legs set flush at the corners, small hanging tray below the edge, light and open
Feel: natural, honest, calm, fresh
Goes with: light wood or white chairs, white walls, pastel accents; Scandinavian kitchens, compact dining rooms or home offices

product.name: IKEA PS 2014
product.description: Solid pine; a natural material that ages beautifully.
